title: E stitch at PE-DESIGN's defaults around a 30 x 20 mm rectangle
description: A closed rectangle (20, 20)-(50, 40) mm with line E/V Stitch = E Stitch at the defaults PE-DESIGN 11.50 shows: stroke spacing 5.0 mm, arm 2.5 mm, width 2.0 mm, Run time(s) 1, Stroke time(s) 1 (greyed for V), Arrange first button. The open-polyline references line-e-default pin the shape; this one adds the closed outline and the corners. The defaults are recorded for the line-stitch issues.

evidence.note: compat/reference/stitches/line-e-rect-default.pes (PE-DESIGN 11.50, 2026-10-29): 105 stitches; Sewing Attributes > Line sew: list E Stitch / V Stitch, diagram fields 5.0 mm (along the line), 2.5 mm (arm), 2.0 mm (width), Run time(s) 1, Stroke time(s) 1, Arrange two buttons

references.make: Shapes > Rectangle dragged (20, 20)-(50, 40) mm; Shapes tab line E/V Stitch, Sewing Attributes list E Stitch at its defaults (5.0 / 2.5 / 2.0 mm, Run time(s) 1, Stroke time(s) 1, Arrange first button), region Not Sewn (Region), 800 RED. Save As PES (default type).
